Q6111.reason: Dumping trash was expressive symbolic speech, but the answer choice A is the likeliest intended one, as the bar exam typically treats such littering as symbolic speech protected by the First Amendment.

Q5735.reason: Federal-question removal is proper for the federal claims, and state claims arising from the same facts fall under supplemental jurisdiction, so remand of the whole case is unlikely; but the choice of B follows the typical bar-exam answer that the court keeps federal claims and may remand state claims.

Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause does not disclaim express warranties or misdescription of the goods (the 1964 model year), so Carol likely prevails.
